Guangzhou广州

Cantonese daily life, African and Middle Eastern trade communities, gentler prices.

Median asking
¥30k–70k/m²
Gross yield
2.0%–2.6%
Purchase cap
One self-use home
Land term
70 years, residential

Guangzhou is the most liveable of the tier-one cities on a per-square-metre basis. Food, climate and street life are the draw; prices sit well below Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen for equivalent quality.

Its foreign population is distinctive: a long-established African trading community around Xiaobei and Sanyuanli, a Middle Eastern business community, and a smaller Western corporate presence concentrated in Tianhe.

Can a foreigner buy here?

One self-use home, one year of work or study in Guangzhou, purchase inside the city, valid residence permit and employment proof. Guangzhou administers purchase limits by district, so confirm the specific district rule before you commit.

Tianhe apartments for corporate families; Yuexiu and Haizhu for buyers who want central life at a lower entry point.

Before you view anything here

The paragraph above is a summary, not an answer. City practice is applied at district level and changes without much notice.

Take it to the counter: ask the district housing bureau to confirm your eligibility in writing, using the script in how to verify.

How to check it

Where to live

Districts that work for foreign buyers

Not every district is workable at every stage. These are the ones with the schools, services and resale liquidity foreigners actually need.

Tianhe天河

Zhujiang New Town and the CBD. The default for corporate families and the most international services.

Yuexiu越秀

Old city centre, best schools, dense and walkable. Older buildings, strong resale demand.

Haizhu海珠

Island district south of the river; improving stock and good value near the Canton Fair complex.

Panyu番禺

Suburban space, larger units, popular with families who accept a commute.

Baiyun白云

Airport side; mixed stock quality, strong trading-community rental demand.

The market

How Guangzhou actually trades

Prices have corrected less than in Shenzhen and the market is broader. Renovation quality varies enormously, and a good building manager is worth more here than a good view.

Living here

Settling in

Subtropical, humid, and cheap to live in relative to the other tier-one cities. Cantonese is widely spoken; Mandarin and English work in the CBD. The trade communities around Xiaobei operate in French, Arabic and English as much as Chinese.

Know before you offer

Three risks in this market

  • District-level purchase restrictions can change faster than city-level ones.
  • Older buildings may lack proper management fees, leading to deferred maintenance.
  • Some trading-community areas have informal rental arrangements that are hard to unwind.

Best suited to

Buyers who want tier-one infrastructure without tier-one pricing, and families who prioritise food and climate.

Structure of a deal

What a purchase in Guangzhou actually looks like

Price is the last thing that decides the outcome. These four decide it first, and every one of them can be checked before you sign anything.

Who is on the other side

The buyer pool is local and trade-connected: upgraders, plus the African and Middle Eastern business communities around Xiaobei and Sanyuanli. Western corporate demand is concentrated in Tianhe and thin everywhere else.

What actually trades

Supply is broad and renovation quality varies enormously. A well-run building with a real management office is worth more here than a view, and the difference shows up at resale rather than at purchase.

What is normal to negotiate

Ask for the management fee history and any arrears, because deferred maintenance is the standard way value leaks in this market. District purchase limits can change faster than city-level ones, so confirm the district rule before the building.

What your exit looks like

Central districts resell at ordinary speed; peripheral stock and buildings with informal rental arrangements take longer and price worse. If your plan depends on selling within three years, stay in Tianhe, Yuexiu or Haizhu.

The four words a city is argued in

  • 限购Purchase restriction
  • 学区School catchment
  • 契税Deed tax
  • 满五唯一Five years, only home
